# scripts/Showcase/GarrisonNight.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Showcase/GarrisonNight.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Six-act ShowNight variant for maps/garrison.gd, positioned from named level marks.
Beats cue intruder actions, guard/search staging, weather, and cinematic subjects while live AI resolves encounters.
Supports @group:<hunt area> subjects for the divided hunt and three endings.

Base: `not declared`. Registered class: `none`.
